# Materials

Gather all of the following before you begin. Links are provided for reference; equivalent parts from other suppliers will work.

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(gt)

tibble::tribble(
  ~Category, ~Item, ~Quantity, ~Source, ~Price, ~Notes,
  
  # 3D Printing
  "3D Printing", "3D printer", "1", NA, "€500-€1000", "Any FDM printer with ≥17.5 cm build plate",
  "3D Printing", "PLA/PETG filament", "~Xg", NA, NA, "Colour of your choice",
  
  # Structural Components
  "Structural Components", "Beams, 10x10x300 mm", "4", "[MakerBeam](https://www.makerbeam.com/makerbeam-300mm-4p-black-makerbeam.html)", "€11,50", NA,
  "Structural Components", "M3 Bolts, countersunk, X mm", "4", "[Farnell](https://de.farnell.com/en-DE/tr-fastenings/m3-8-kh10mc-z100/screw-socket-csk-bzp-m3x8-pk100/dp/1420649)", "€8,65", "Pack of 100",
  "Structural Components", "M3 Bolts, square head, 6 mm", "8", "[MakerBeam](https://www.makerbeam.com/makerbeam-square-headed-bolts-6mm-250p-for-makerbe.html)", "€13,98", "Pack of 250 pieces",
  "Structural Components", "Knurled nuts", "8", "[MakerBeam](https://www.makerbeam.com/makerbeam-knurled-nuts-4p.html)", "€4,90", NA,
  
  # Lighting
  "Lighting", "LED strip, infrared", "40 cm", "[LEDLightsWorld](https://www.ledlightsworld.com/de-de/products/850nm-smd2835-dc12v-infrared-led-strip-light-night-vision-ir-for-security-60-120-240-leds-m-5-meters-ip00-ip65?_pos=1&_psq=ir&_ss=e&_v=1.0&variant=17836968607834)", "~€50", "850 nm or 940 nm; one roll = 5 m",
  "Lighting", "End click connector", "1", NA, NA, "Must match strip width",
  "Lighting", "LED strip connectors, corner, 2-pin, 8 mm", "3", NA, "€5", "Must match strip width",
  "Lighting", "12V power supply", "1", NA, NA, "For LED strips",
  "Lighting", "LED Strip dimmer", "1", "[LEDLightsWorld](https://www.ledlightsworld.com/en-de/products/dc-12v-24v-6amp-rotary-switch-inline-dimmer?_pos=9&_sid=7654f68a3&_ss=r)", "€5", NA,
  "Lighting", "Diffuser fabric", "1 piece", NA, NA, "White ripstop nylon or similar; ~20 x 15 cm",
  
  # Assembly Supplies
  "Assembly Supplies", "Neodymium magnets (Ø6 x 2 mm)", "X", NA, NA, "Quantity depends on configuration",
  "Assembly Supplies", "Superglue (cyanoacrylate)", "1", NA, NA, "Gorilla Glue or similar",
  "Assembly Supplies", "Small cable ties", "~10", NA, NA, "For cable management",
  "Assembly Supplies", "Disposable gloves", "1 pair", NA, NA, "Nitrile or latex",
  "Assembly Supplies", "Paper towels", "A few sheets", NA, NA, "For wiping excess glue",
  "Assembly Supplies", "Stanley knife / scissors", "1", NA, NA, "For cutting LED strips and fabric",
  "Assembly Supplies", "M3 Allen Key", "1", "[Link](https://www.makerbeam.com/makerbeam-allen-key-1p.html)", "€1,00", NA,
) |>
  gt(groupname_col = "Category") |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(Item, Source)) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  cols_label(
    Item = "Item",
    Quantity = "Quantity",
    Source = "Source",
    Price = "Price",
    Notes = "Notes"
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    Item ~ pct(30),
    Quantity ~ pct(10),
    Source ~ pct(20),
    Price ~ pct(10),
    Notes ~ pct(30)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#c4dbf4ff"),
      cell_text(weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "#d3d3d3", weight = px(1)),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = css(padding.left = "20px"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Item)
  ) |> 
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100),
    row_group.padding = px(10)
  )
```
